verdict.rationale: Baseten documents a public inference API that is OpenAI-compatible, with Anthropic Messages support in beta. It also documents streaming over SSE, async inference returning request IDs with webhook or polling, structured outputs, function calling, rate-limit headers, usage queries by API key, and Loops training steps issued as API calls. Together these let a user drive the core product programmatically. Missing for 10: an explicitly documented management/control-plane REST API for deploying and configuring models (deployment evidence points to the CLI/Truss), a discoverable OpenAPI spec (probes returned 404), and independent hands-on corroboration of the API surface.
